shortDescription: Create, update or remove a firewall rule.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter name or UUID in which to operate.

options.name: firewall_rule
options.description: The Firewall Rule name or UUID.

options.name: icmp_code
options.description: Defines the allowed code (from 0 to 254) if protocol ICMP or ICMPv6 is chosen. Value null allows all codes.

options.name: icmp_type
options.description: Defines the allowed type (from 0 to 254) if the protocol ICMP or ICMPv6 is chosen. Value null allows all types.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: The IP version for this rule. If sourceIp or targetIp are specified, you can omit this value - the IP version will then be deduced from the IP address(es) used; if you specify it anyway, it must match the specified IP address(es). If neither sourceIp nor targetIp are specified, this rule allows traffic only for the specified IP version. If neither sourceIp, targetIp nor ipVersion are specified, this rule will only allow IPv4 traffic.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the  resource.

options.name: nic
options.description: The NIC name or UUID.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: port_range_end
options.description: Defines the end range of the allowed port (from 1 to 65535) if the protocol TCP or UDP is chosen. Leave portRangeStart and portRangeEnd null to allow all ports.

options.name: port_range_start
options.description: Defines the start range of the allowed port (from 1 to 65535) if protocol TCP or UDP is chosen. Leave portRangeStart and portRangeEnd value null to allow all ports.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol for the rule. Property cannot be modified after it is created (disallowed in update requests).

options.name: server
options.description: The server name or UUID.

options.name: source_ip
options.description: Only traffic originating from the respective IP address (or CIDR block) is allowed. Value null allows traffic from any IP address (according to the selected ipVersion).

options.name: source_mac
options.description: Only traffic originating from the respective MAC address is allowed. Valid format: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff. Value null allows traffic from any MAC address.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: target_ip
options.description: If the target NIC has multiple IP addresses, only the traffic directed to the respective IP address (or CIDR block) of the NIC is allowed. Value null allows traffic to any target IP address (according to the selected ipVersion).

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
